body:
Founder real-time: 'ok but after we have a compiler we also need to write parena in parena' -> 'not c' -> 'silly' (NORTHSTAR.md's own 'Self-hosting' section) -- picked up again 2026-08-27 ('self hosted compiler' -> 'continue') now that its own gating condition is met: VS0 is complete, all 5 DoD domains done and CI-green. New selfhost/lexer.prn: a real, faithful PARENA-language port of src/lexer.c (VS0's own C tokenizer), compiled BY the existing C-based parena-c -- the first domain toward a real PARENA-in-PARENA pipeline, not a claim of already being self-hosted. Real design departures forced by VS0's own confirmed current limits (no struct field mutation, no tuple returns): every 'advance' returns a NEW Lexer value; lexer-next returns a LexStep struct bundling the produced Token + advanced Lexer, a named-struct stand-in for a tuple return. Real compiler bugs found and fixed along the way (confirmed live via actual gcc errors self-hosting this file surfaced): emit_if/emit_binop in src/emit.c built their own final C expression text via a fixed 512/1024-byte snprintf buffer, silently truncating mid-identifier once a deeply-nested cond/if/comparison chain's combined text exceeded it (confirmed via a real "'LexSte' undeclared; did you mean 'LexStep'?" gcc error) -- the exact class of bug emit_cond was already written to avoid, just not yet applied here or to 3 more sb_appendf return-statement call sites. Fixed via the same growable StrBuf + direct sb_append pattern emit_cond already established (~25 more fixed-buffer sites in emit.c are unaudited, a real, separate, deferred systemic-review item). Also found and applied: a match-bound Ok payload's own emitted C variable stays void* (a real, already-documented convention in stdlib/regex/syntax.prn's own header comment, get-field (deref x) :field), used here for the first time outside that one file. string.prn gains char-from-code. 60 real assertions in tests/test_selfhost_lexer.c, hand-traced against src/lexer.c's own real behavior. Full local suite + bazel build/test + real mingw cross-compile all clean, zero regressions, CI green on all 4 platform jobs including the compiler-level change verified under real macOS Clang and Windows MSYS2 gcc. NORTHSTAR.md's own 'Self-hosting' section updated from 'not started' to reflect this real first step. PARENA commit bcc7cc5, release v0.85.0.

⚓ ☃
title: v0.85.0: real first step toward a self-hosted PARENA compiler -- lexer.prn
